aiOverview.content: Alfredo Adame (born June 10, 1958) is a prominent 67-year-old Mexican actor, producer, and television host known for telenovelas like De frente al sol and for participating in reality shows such as La Casa de los Famosos. He is a controversial figure in Mexican media with a career spanning over 40 TV shows and films. Key Details About Alfredo Adame: Age and Birthplace: Born on June 10, 1958, in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. Career: Known for his roles in Mi segunda madre (1989), De frente al sol (1992), and Retrato de familia (1995). Recently, he has been involved in reality television, including La Casa de los Famosos All Stars. Family: Previously married to Mary Paz Banquells, with whom he has children, and to Diana Golden. Controversy: Frequently featured in media for his outspoken nature and participation in reality TV confrontations. Other "Adame" References: Music: There is an American DJ and producer named ADAME based in Miami known for Afro Melodic House. Surname: Adame has origins as a name meaning "son of the red earth," often with Indigenous American and Spanish roots. Other people with the surname include politician Marco Antonio Adame and Bexar County Clerk Lucy Adame-Clark.
